name: overlays/popover
title: Popover
description: Anchored content that flips and shifts to stay visible.

files.content:
export { Popover } from './Popover';
export type { PopoverProps } from './Popover';

keyboard.action: Open or close the popover from its button.
Move through the popover’s content; leaving it closes it.
Close the popover and return focus to its button.

notes: The panel is a non-modal `dialog` labelled by its title. The page stays usable while it is open.
Focus moves into the popover when it opens and back to the button when Escape closes it.
It closes on a click outside and when focus leaves it, so it never lingers unseen.
It sits in the top layer through the Popover API, so no container can clip it.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The popover appears without its short slide from the anchor.
